title: Felt the Virgin Mary's presence and guidance in Portugal

tellings.quote: related. This plus my encounter I'd had with her in Portugal, where I hadn't met her, but I felt her mind and thoughts.

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, presented on Jesse Michels's podcast as a former CIA chief (the CIA is the US foreign intelligence agency), says that in Portugal, around the late 1990s, he had an encounter with the Virgin Mary, the mother of Jesus. He says he never met her in person but felt her mind and thoughts, and her guidance. He ties this to other strange experiences of his, which would point to a contact with something beyond the ordinary world.
